title: Entity growth batch 02 — Bitget Wallet
notes: Candidate-only breadth-growth record under issue #195. Canonical publication prohibited until Batch 02 review completes.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Web3 wallet ecosystem that began as BitKeep in 2018 and rebranded to Bitget Wallet in 2023.
entities.notes: First-party Bitget Wallet history states that BitKeep began in 2018 and was rebranded to Bitget Wallet on 2023-08-10. The rebrand preserves the wallet entity lineage rather than creating a new wallet entity.

products.summary: Current Bitget Wallet mobile application for self-custodial multichain Web3 wallet use on iOS and Android.
products.notes: The 2023-08-10 BitKeep-to-Bitget Wallet change is a brand rebrand, not a defensible initial product-launch date. The mobile product preserves the earlier BitKeep Wallet lineage, but its exact initial launch date remains unresolved. Browser extension distribution has a distinct runtime and is intentionally deferred as a separate product boundary.

evidence.title: BitKeep Upgrades to Bitget Wallet: A Letter From the Team
evidence.notes: First-party history states BitKeep began in 2018 and records the formal brand upgrade to Bitget Wallet on 2023-08-10. WLR uses it for entity continuity and the 2018 year-level origin, not as a new product-launch date.

evidence.title: Best Free Crypto Wallet for Web3
evidence.notes: Current first-party wallet page separately offers Google Play, App Store and Android APK mobile distributions and Chrome extension distribution, supporting the mobile-app product boundary and self-custodial current status.
